youtube_title: Nosebleed? Tilt Head Back? That's Wrong | Body Fix #8 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #8. Nosebleed, and everyone says TILT YOUR HEAD BACK! Bro, that's the mistake.
B is right. Lean FORWARD and pinch the soft part of your nose.
Head back sends blood down your throat. It can make you sick.
Fix: Pinch for 10-15 MIN, breathe through your mouth, cold pack on the bridge.
Red flags: Bleeding over 15 min, after a head injury, or often? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Nosebleed
